name: 001_rename_source_to_dest.sh
expected: src gone, dst is a file holding src's content
manpage_quote: Rename SOURCE to DEST, or move SOURCE(s) to DIRECTORY.

name: 002_move_source_into_directory.sh
exercises: move a single SOURCE into an existing DIRECTORY
expected: file lands inside dir under its basename, original gone
manpage_quote: mv [OPTION]... SOURCE... DIRECTORY

name: 003_move_multiple_sources_into_directory.sh
exercises: move multiple SOURCE arguments into a DIRECTORY
expected: all sources moved into dir, originals gone
manpage_quote: mv [OPTION]... SOURCE... DIRECTORY

name: 004_target_directory_flag.sh
expected: both sources inside target dir, originals gone
manpage_quote: move all SOURCE arguments into DIRECTORY

name: 005_target_directory_long_flag.sh
expected: source moved into target dir, original gone
manpage_quote: -t, --target-directory=DIRECTORY

name: 006_no_target_directory_treats_dest_as_file.sh
exercises: -T treats DEST as a normal file
expected: dst is a file (rename), not a directory move
manpage_quote: treat DEST as a normal file

name: 007_force_overwrite_no_prompt.sh
expected: existing dst overwritten with src content
manpage_quote: do not prompt before overwriting

name: 008_no_clobber_keeps_existing.sh
expected: dst keeps its old content
manpage_quote: do not overwrite an existing file

name: 009_interactive_no_response_keeps_existing.sh
stderr: -i overwrote destination despite no affirmative prompt answer
exercises: -i, --interactive prompts; no answer means no overwrite
expected: dst keeps its old content when prompt not affirmed
manpage_quote: prompt before overwrite

name: 010_backup_long_creates_tilde.sh
expected: dst~ holds previous content, dst holds new
manpage_quote: make a backup of each existing destination file

name: 011_backup_short_b_creates_tilde.sh
expected: dst~ holds previous content
manpage_quote: like --backup but does not accept an argument

name: 012_suffix_override.sh
expected: backup uses .bak suffix, no dst~ created
manpage_quote: override the usual backup suffix

name: 013_suffix_short_S.sh
exercises: -S SUFFIX short form overrides backup suffix
expected: backup uses .bak suffix
manpage_quote: -S, --suffix=SUFFIX

name: 014_simple_backup_suffix_env.sh
expected: backup uses .sb suffix from env
manpage_quote:
The backup suffix is '~', unless set with --suffix or
       SIMPLE_BACKUP_SUFFIX.

name: 015_backup_numbered.sh
expected: dst.~1~ holds previous content
manpage_quote: make numbered backups

name: 016_update_older_replaces_older_dest.sh
expected: older dst replaced with src content
manpage_quote:
results in files being replaced if they're older than the corresponding
       source file.

name: 017_update_older_keeps_newer_dest.sh
exercises: --update=older does not replace dest newer than source
expected: newer dst keeps its content
manpage_quote:
results in files being replaced if they're older than the corresponding
       source file.

name: 018_update_none_skips_silently.sh
expected: dst unchanged and exit status 0
manpage_quote:
no files in
       the destination are replaced, and skipped files do not induce a
       failure.

name: 019_update_all_replaces.sh
expected: dst replaced with src content regardless of age
manpage_quote:
all existing files in the destination being
       replaced.

name: 020_verbose_prints_arrow.sh
expected: stdout names both source and destination
manpage_quote: explain what is being done

name: 021_exchange_swaps_source_and_dest.sh
stderr:
mv: unrecognized option '--exchange'
mv: Try 'mv --help' for more information.
expected: src and dst contents are swapped
manpage_quote: exchange source and destination

name: 022_strip_trailing_slashes.sh
expected: file source with trailing slash moved as a file
manpage_quote: remove any trailing slashes from each SOURCE argument

name: 023_final_of_nf_takes_effect.sh
exercises: -n -f: only final option takes effect (-f wins)
expected: dst overwritten with src content
manpage_quote:
If you specify more than one of -i, -f, -n, only the final one takes
       effect.

name: 024_final_of_fn_takes_effect.sh
exercises: -f -n: only final option takes effect (-n wins)
expected: dst keeps old content
manpage_quote:
If you specify more than one of -i, -f, -n, only the final one takes
       effect.

name: 025_version_outputs_info.sh
expected: non-empty version output
manpage_quote: output version information and exit

name: 026_nonexistent_source_fails.sh
stderr: mv: cannot stat '/tmp/tmp.bUqi900MN4/does_not_exist': No such file or directory (os error 2)
exercises: nonexistent SOURCE is a documented error
expected: mv exits nonzero
manpage_quote: Rename SOURCE to DEST, or move SOURCE(s) to DIRECTORY.

name: 027_update_none_fail_induces_failure.sh
expected: mv exits nonzero, dst unchanged
manpage_quote: any skipped files are diagnosed and induce a failure.

name: 028_no_target_directory_existing_dir_fails.sh
stderr: mv: cannot move '/tmp/tmp.Sz1UNP5gWU/src' to '/tmp/tmp.Sz1UNP5gWU/destdir': Is a directory (os error 21)
exercises: -T onto an existing directory must fail
expected: mv exits nonzero, src untouched
manpage_quote: treat DEST as a normal file

name: 029_exchange_missing_dest_fails.sh
stderr:
mv: unrecognized option '--exchange'
mv: Try 'mv --help' for more information.
exercises: --exchange with a nonexistent destination must fail
expected: mv exits nonzero
manpage_quote: exchange source and destination

name: 030_debug_implies_verbose.sh
stderr:
mv: unrecognized option '--debug'
mv: Try 'mv --help' for more information.
expected: stdout names src and dst, move succeeds
manpage_quote: explain how a file is copied.  Implies -v
